FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 390
Committee: Commerce and Small Business Sponsor: Representative Mark Shirey
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 04/08/2025
REVISED
House Bill 390 as introduced would lower the minimum balance that must be maintained in the
Alabama Drycleaning Environmental Response Trust Fund from $1 million, under current law,
to $250,000 beginning in Fiscal Year 2026.
The approximate balance of this fund is $1.19 million, as of April 2025.
